prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered junction against signal and struck driver side door. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured and placed in file.

Entry 2: Third party driver contacted. Liability disputed; third party states insured entered on amber. Recorded statements requested from both drivers and from the witness listed on the police report. Scene diagram and traffic camera footage from nearby business requested.

Entry 3: Claimant's attorney has notified this office of representation. All further contact to go through counsel. Claimant reports concussion diagnosis and is off work pending follow-up with treating physician. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel. Reserve set pending records.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspected at repair facility. Estimate shows structural damage to driver side and intrusion into B-pillar area; vehicle likely total loss pending valuation. Rental coverage confirmed for insured during repair period. Supervisor review requested given injury involvement and counsel representation.

Entry 5: Witness statement received and consistent with insured account of green light. Camera footage reviewed; signal phase appears to favor insured direction but timing unclear. Liability position under review. File referred to bodily injury unit for evaluation of medical records once received from counsel. Next diary set for follow-up with counsel.
